name: Window-Closing Visibility Detection
definition: An algorithm for quickly computing which boxes (representing subvolumes or portals) are in the current viewing frustum during navigation. It uses an Aggregate Cull Window (ACW) to determine visibility of subsequent boxes.
summary: Window-Closing Visibility Detection is a conservative culling method for virtual colonoscopy that iteratively shrinks a 2D screen-space window to identify visible subvolumes without expensive frustum tests.
